note: Compliance assertions for 33(11). Auto-evaluated after calc; produces 🟢/🟡/🔴 rows.

checks.label: Gross plot area entered and positive
checks.recommended_action: Enter gross plot area from PRC / title records.

checks.label: Primary road width ≥ 9 m
checks.recommended_action: Road widths below 9m may render the scheme non-viable. Verify DP plan and abutting road width.

checks.label: Number of flats entered and positive
checks.recommended_action: Confirm eligible flat count from society records.

checks.label: Development zone selected
checks.recommended_action: Select Island City or Suburbs & Extended Suburbs.

checks.label: Zonal FSI in typical range 1.00 – 1.33
checks.recommended_action: Zonal FSI is 1.00 (Suburbs) or 1.33 (Island City). Verify.

checks.label: Additional FSI ≤ 3.00 (statutory cap for Suburbs, Island Max 2.67)
checks.recommended_action: Additional FSI capped at 2.67 (Island) or 3.00 (Suburbs). Verify inputs.

checks.label: SRA share of Additional FSI in industry range 60-70%
checks.recommended_action: Industry standard is 63% SRA / 37% Sale+Society. Values outside 60-70% need review.

checks.label: Full Scheme FSI ≤ 5.40 (4.0 + 35% fungible)
checks.recommended_action: Reduce Additional FSI or fungible % to bring total ≤ 5.40.

checks.label: Net plot area (after deductions) is positive
checks.recommended_action: Setback + amenity deductions exceed gross plot. Verify inputs.

checks.label: SRA-PTC share is positive (developer must hand over PTC)
checks.recommended_action: If Additional FSI is 0, SRA-PTC share is 0 — scheme reduces to a normal Reg 30 redevelopment. Verify.
